articleTitle: Design and Implementation of College English Teaching Quality Evaluation System Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the design and development of college English system, the analytic hierarchy process is used to analyze the system application, so that we can use the idea of software engineering to solve practical problems. The author has a good grasp of the system development method of ASP.NET structure, an in-depth understanding of the current college English teaching management process, and an in-depth understanding of the needs of teaching quality evaluation. Based on the research and design of the system, we can grasp the current situation, current problems and development direction of the college English teaching evaluation and analysis system, so as to improve it.

articleTitle: Discussion on Practice and Promotion Strategy of College Music Education Informatization Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The application of artificial intelligence (AI) in music education (ME) has broken the traditional ME model and greatly improved the quality of music teaching. The purpose of this article is to promote the in-depth integration of college music and information education by discussing the informationization of college ME under AI. In this paper, we conducted a questionnaire survey on students from several major universities in City A to understand the current status of the informationization of ME in universities, and randomly selected some students for interviews. It is concluded that 88.1% of the students surveyed believe that the combination of informatization and ME has enriched music resources; 73.81% of the students surveyed believed that education informatization promoted communication between teachers and students and broadened their academic horizons. The research in this article is helpful to the application of informatization of ME in colleges and universities (CAU), and promotes the equity of ME resources in CAU, thereby promoting the innovative development of ME.

articleTitle: Integration of English Teaching and Internet Distance Education Based on Computer-aided Teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The development of new computer technologies such as new media technology and the Internet has greatly promoted the reform of college English teaching. Today, Internet-based distance education has greatly optimized the environment for students to learn English, and has built a relatively open teaching platform through emerging technologies such as the Internet, breaking the unreasonable allocation of resources under the traditional teaching model and promoting the vigorous development of education which plays a vital role. How to learn new teaching ideas through the resources provided by the Internet, construct a brand-new English teaching environment, and improve students' enthusiasm for learning have begun to become a new topic facing English teachers. However, there are also some problems and obstacles to the development of computer-aided instruction and the Internet; this article discusses this, analyzes some reasons, and puts forward the author's views. This article introduces the relationship between each subsystem and their functions, and uses UML technology to model the college English teaching system.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Causes and Prevention of Sports Injuries in School Physical Education and Training Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Teaching reform has promoted the transformation of school physical education, and all walks of life have gradually strengthened the emphasis on school physical education. Because of its own learning characteristics, school physical education is prone to accidents in teaching and training, resulting in sports injuries to students. This article aims to reduce the sports injuries in physical education and training in schools by discussing the causes and prevention measures of sports injuries in sports training. This article analyzes the location and causes of sports injuries by conducting a questionnaire survey on sophomore students from three colleges and universities in a province. It is concluded that among the causes of injury, inadequate preparation for activities leads to the highest proportion of injuries, up to 24.80%; 19.40% of students are injured due to non-standard technical actions; Accidents caused injuries accounted for 7.20%. And put forward preventive measures against the causes of students' sports injuries, in order to reduce the students' sports injuries in training and promote the comprehensive development of students' physical and mental health.

articleTitle: Application of Electromagnetic Simulation in the Course of “Microwave Technology and Antenna”
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As a basic course for undergraduates, “microwave technology and antenna” is offered in the majors of electronic information in most universities. The basis of this course is complex and abstract knowledge concepts, which has always been considered as a difficult course for teachers and students. This article attempts to provide some suggestions for the teaching reform of this course from the perspective of introducing electromagnetic simulation. Through further construction, it can be built into an electromagnetic virtual simulation test online platform to better serve this course.

articleTitle: Research on Educational Management System and Operation Mechanism Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the national implementation of the great development strategy of vocational education, higher vocational education has made great progress, but there are still shortcomings in the management system and operation mechanism. Economic and social development of high speed, high efficiency requirements, is bound to need a lot of talent support, but also generated a huge amount of data information. Through data mining technology, we can find some useful knowledge hidden behind a large number of data, and use these knowledge to guide managers to improve management means and strengthen management pertinently. With the advancement of educational informationization, the educational management system and operation mechanism have gradually realized informationization. Compared with the traditional educational management means, it has significantly improved in efficiency, benefit and effect. This has laid a good foundation for the application of data mining technology in education management. In the future learning society, the high integration of education and information technology is becoming a new trend of education development all over the world, which will give birth to a brand-new economic growth model and education form.

articleTitle: English Multimedia Teaching Resources Integration System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the era of big data, the integration and development of English teaching resources is faced with the challenge of large amount, diversity and hidden value of resources and data. Under the new situation, multimedia teaching has great practical significance. This requires contemporary English teachers to master the requirements and basic operations of multimedia teaching and integrate modern information technology with English teaching methods. Advanced network technologies such as cloud computing must be applied to multimedia teaching resources in colleges and universities to solve the problems of security and hardware resources encountered in the integration process. In the face of the arrival of the big data era, English teachers should change their teaching concepts in time, actively adapt to the requirements of big data era for teachers and students, reasonably use network data resources to develop English teaching resources, and achieve English teaching objectives. This paper analyzes the characteristics and application of big data, expounds the difficulties in the process of English multimedia teaching resources integration, and expounds the ways of school education resources integration and transformation.

articleTitle: Application and Research of Virtual Reality Technology Based on Big Data in College Teaching Field
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Virtual reality technology (VR for short) is a new technology combining computer technology and simulation technology, which uses computers to generate a simulation environment and immerse users in the environment. Virtual reality technology can use virtual simulation software to model, build virtual instruments and scenes, and enable users to learn and operate simulation experiments in virtual scenes. Big data technology has been applied in various fields, and it can also be applied to education. Using educational data mining technology and learning analysis technology, the corresponding model in the field of education is constructed, and the special relationship between the acquired educational data is explored. This paper introduces the concept of virtual reality technology in detail, and discusses the application of virtual reality technology in college teaching and the significance of modern educational technology in college teaching.

articleTitle: The Reform of Physical Education in Colleges and Universities Should Focus on Innovation and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Under the premise of national sports, the country is paying more and more attention to students' physical health, which delivers higher requirements for physical education in schools. This paper, based on the practice of physical education in a university, tries to combine physical education with information technology, and develops a system suitable for the analysis and management of students' physical education quality in this university, so as to improve the quality of physical education and the efficiency of the management of students' physical fitness. Through the application of data mining technology and the use of database technology, this paper designs and develops a three-layer framework of B/S technology for the analysis and management of college students' quality.

articleTitle: Exploration and Research on the Path of Cultivating the Craftsman Spirit of Computer Talents in Application-oriented Universities
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The rapid development of information technology era and progress not only requires the computer professional students have rich theoretical basis, high professional ability, innovation ability and practice ability, also requires a noble professional ethics, perfect personality, positive attitude, to adapt to the fierce competition environment, and hard work, to meet the needs of future employment market. The cultivation of craftsman spirit of computer talents in application-oriented universities is a critical period in the university, and it is particularly important to establish a firm craftsman spirit for the future career development path of computer majors. It is good for students to improve their personal quality, promote students to realize their own value, enhance their professional ethics, help students to form the right three-outlook, for the future to become an excellent, noble socialist construction talent lay a good foundation.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis of mathematical knowledge points based on word co-occurrence and clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The connection between knowledge points in teaching resources cannot be represented accurately. A method based on word co-occurrence and cluster analysis is proposed. First, the subject word extraction algorithm is used to extract the subject words; then the word co-occurrence analysis method is used to analyze the association relationship of the subject word pairs and visualize; finally, cluster analysis is performed on the basis of the association statistical characteristics to find the hidden subject clusters. Taking high school mathematics test question resources as an example, applying the method can better reflect the relationship between knowledge points.

articleTitle: Teaching Mode Reform of Electrotechnics and Electronics Driven by Task
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Electrical engineering and electronics is a professional basic course that is just involved for students. It has many teaching contents and is difficult to learn. Moreover, the course develops rapidly and is widely used. In the teaching process, it shows strong conceptuality, many theories, and flexible circuit changes. It is difficult to understand, difficult to remember and difficult to learn. The traditional teaching model can no longer meet the demand, and the teaching model needs to be reformed urgently. This article takes the design of a digital electronic clock that is closely connected to real life as the subject task. The teacher puts forward the requirements. By training students to consult materials, discuss with classmates, design circuits, error correction and rectification, and simulation, the learning process is deepened. The knowledge and understanding of the theoretical knowledge of the circuit part have tested the students' ability to apply what they have learned in the classroom to practice, which has improved the students' interest in learning and the ability to think independently, laying a good foundation for cultivating students' ability to learn for life.

articleTitle: On a Machine Learning Based Method for Store Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Since the consuming behavior of customers is hard to predict and most data is diversified and unclassified in the real world, it is of great importance to collect those data and analyze them so as to improve the promotion strategy and total profit for business activity. To solve this problem, an unsupervised model in machine learning is utilized to analyze the transaction dataset and then classify the stores into multiple groups. A particular example dataset of a shopping mall is represented to demonstrate that the proposed model is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Effect of the information intervention on improving physical health of obese college students
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: An intervention experiment was conducted on an obese student through information intervention. Based on the theory of cognition and motivation, this paper discusses the application of information intervention in obese college students through the case study. According to the research, after the intervention of information for four months, it can improve college students' recognition and attention to beauty of body shape. And it can stimulate their motivation to seek solutions actively and maintain their motivation level continuously. It can also promote college students to participate in scientific sports and exercise, in order to improve their health metrics. Finally, the students' body shape has been improved significantly.

articleTitle: A Study on the Training Mode of Preschool Education Talents in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the age of artificial intelligence (AI), it is imperative to reform the talent training mode of preschool education. In the face of the opportunities and challenges of AI, the cultivation of preschool talents should advance with the times. In this paper, the contents of preschool educator training in the university are studied, the shortcomings of preschool educator training in the AI era are explored, and the modes for colleges to foster preschool educators for the society are studied. The author puts forward such solutions as optimizing AI technology and the curriculum knowledge structure related to preschool education and optimizing the talent training and teaching methods.

articleTitle: The Mixed Teaching Mode of College Oral English in the Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, the traditional teaching model has been insufficient to meet the requirements of college students to improve their self-ability in oral English. Hybrid teaching mode is the necessity of the development of the times, which is derived from the information technology era we are in. Generally speaking, it refers mainly to the effective combination of online learning and traditional teaching in the classroom personally, which is very common in life now. A way of learning and training. This document has therefore carried out an investigation, namely the study of the mixed teaching of the English language in the context of the large data. This document conducts research combining the experimental comparison method and the bibliography survey method, Reference to relevant domestic and foreign materials and English teacher conversation in China Current situation summarises mixed oral strategies and methods teaching English at the time of the great data and verifying its relevance by means of an experimental comparison. The results of this article's research are very useful and can be used as a reference for the reform of mixed language teaching on the Chinese base.

articleTitle: Design and Construction of "C Language Programming" Network Course Based on CDIO
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: CDIO Conceive is the abbreviation of conceptual, Design, Implement and Operate. In this paper, combined with the current teaching situation of "C language programming" course, based on CDIO engineering education concept, the construction and implementation method of "integration of teaching, learning and doing" in the network course of "C language programming" was introduced, and the integrated teaching system such as integrated curriculum system, integrated training environment, integrated curriculum standards and teaching materials, and integrated teaching team was put forward. The system takes students as the main body, teachers as the leading factor, the content setting is from simple to comprehensive, and the teaching methods are flexible and changeable. Practice has proved that the new teaching model plays a positive role in cultivating students’ ability to analyze and solve problems, practice and team cooperation.

articleTitle: The Design of College Students’ Ideological Dynamic Visualization Management Information System under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: College students are advanced in thinking, who are senior and specialized professionals trained by the nation. They have independent thinking skills, and often have unique views and opinions on events. In this paper, an index is constructed to solve the difficulty of monitoring the ideological dynamics of college students, since the ideological dynamics of college students is difficulty to be captured. In particular, a visualization management information system is developed to monitor the ideological dynamics of college students based on big data. This system is based on the B/S architecture, which uses the SQL Server database. This system realizes the functions of index modification, document entry, word segmentation statistics, index correlation, keyword search, index analysis, document analysis. By using the visualization tool, the online comments, study reports and other material content are visually displayed. Therefore, the education management can analyze the current status and identify problems of college students' ideological dynamics, based on the data visualization of college students' ideological dynamics in the system. Therefore, a better decision-making basis can be obtained to enhance the ideological education of college students.

articleTitle: Research Field of Mobile Learning in China: Current Situation and Enlightenment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Taking the mobile learning literature in the CNKI journal database as the research sample, this paper conducted in-depth research and analysis on the related literature by using research methods such as bibliometrics, social network analysis, and multi-dimensional scaling analysis. The results show that: (1) The research results increased significantly, mainly distributed in pedagogy, computer science, with obvious “centralization-decentralization” characteristics; (2) low degree of research cooperation and small scale of cooperation restrict the further research and development of mobile learning; (3) In the past two decades, mobile learning research in China has experienced three stages: initial stage, rapid development stage and comprehensive deepening stage; (4) At present, the three major themes of mobile learning research are mobile learning application mode research, mobile learning support environment research, mobile learning theory research. Flipped classroom, micro learning, mobile learning plafform, mobile teaching mode are the current research hotspot. In the future, the healthy development of mobile learning research requires not only strengthening communication and cooperation, but also focusing on the transformation of research paradigm, as well as strengthening the formulation of industry standards.

articleTitle: A study on the acceptance and influencing factors of online teaching in China - Taking mosoteach cloud class as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The theory of Decomposed Theory of Planned Behavior (DTPB) was applied to explore students' acceptance of online classes. Taking “Mosoteach cloud class” in China universities as an example, the research model was constructed and the research hypothesis was put forward, and 298 valid questionnaires were collected through questionnaires. Using SPSS & Smartpls3.29 software to verify the model. Overall, the results indicate that the acceptance of students to cloud classes is mainly affected by compatibility, subjective norms and perceived usefulness. The effects of compatibility and subjective norms exceed perceived usefulness, and the acceptance varies on different genders or different grades. Finally, the future research direction and suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: The Joint Development of College Labor Education and Quality Education Based on the New Era
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Labor education refers to the education that schools train students' correct labor concepts and consciousness and master certain labor skills through specialized labor courses. Quality-oriented education is the inevitable result of the synchronous development of education and society, and it is an important symbol of putting modern educational thoughts into practice in an all-round way. In order to improve the quality of the educated in an all-round way, labor practice education is an indispensable independent content. With the deepening of higher education reform, if we only pay attention to instrumental value and neglect educational value from humanity, higher education will inevitably lose its proper character and cultural taste. This paper first analyzes the main problems and causes of labor education in Colleges and universities in the new era, and then puts forward the common development countermeasures of labor education and quality education in Colleges and universities in the new era. The concrete implementation of these countermeasures needs corresponding system guarantee and environmental protection, and the operability of some countermeasures also needs to be constantly tested in practice.

articleTitle: The New Role of College English Teachers in MOOC Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: College English teachers should recognize the changes brought by massive open online courses to their own values and roles in teaching, make full use of online and offline language learning resources, play a new role and improve their teaching ability. They should give full play to their absolute advantages in English language, to develop courses according to the needs of students, explore courses of English for special purposes, and guide students to participate in MOOC learning to improve their ability of English language application.

articleTitle: An Algorithm of Data Skew in Spark Based on Partition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To solve the problem of data skew, many algorithms have been proposed at present. Due to different operating mechanisms, many advantages of hadoop-based algorithms cannot be fully realized in spark. However, most proposed algorithms are hadoop-based. Tang zhuo et al. proposed SKRSP, an adaptive partitioning method to deal with data skew in spark application. Compared with previous researches, this algorithm can more effectively alleviate the problems of data skew. Moreover, with the increase of data skew, the effect of this algorithm to deal with data skew is more and more significant. However, the research of this algorithm is based on the same hardware and software configuration of the nodes in the cluster. This paper presents a load balancing and key redistribution algorithm based on Spark (LBKRS) which optimizes the SKRSP algorithm from the point of view of load balancing. By monitoring the CPU utilization, memory utilization and other information of the calculation nodes, the LBKRS algorithm has a better effect on the data skew of different configuration nodes and is more adaptable to the actual production situation.

articleTitle: Research on Ways to Improve College Students’ Moral Cultivation Based on Virtual Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: According to the Ten-year Development Plan of Educational Informatization (2011-2020) and other relevant requirements, the Ministry of Education focuses on promoting the deep integration of information technology and experimental teaching of higher education. Influenced by the COVID-19 epidemic in 2020, large-scale online teaching has been carried out in colleges and universities across the country, and the teaching methods of virtual simulation are constantly developing. Virtual simulation experimental teaching methods will help to further promote the innovative development of ideological and political work in colleges and universities. Adopting virtual simulation technology to display Confucian etiquette culture and carry forward the etiquette culture tradition and etiquette style of respecting etiquette, respecting harmony and harmony, stressing benevolence, beauty and goodness, can make students experience virtual participation and appreciate the spirit of awe, humility and self-discipline of etiquette culture, improve the moral cultivation level of college students in the new era, and strive to improve the experimental teaching quality and practical education level of higher education.

articleTitle: A Study on the Mode of Training Program for Broadcasting and Hosting Art Major in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the increasing impact of technology on all walks of life, the voice that artificial intelligence will replace broadcasters and hosts is also gradually sounded. It is of great significance how to face the challenge, break through a tight encirclement, and ride on the era express, and produces talents of the broadcasting and hosting art major in line with national demands. Through analysis on the training mode of broadcasting and hosting art major in colleges and universities, this Thesis studies how to train interdisciplinary graduates that are competent with the artificial intelligence technology and proficient in professional knowledge for the society, so as to render certain reference suggestions for promoting educational reform.

articleTitle: Research on the Whole Teaching Process and Influencing Variables in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies the whole process of teaching in higher vocational colleges. The whole process of teaching and its management are the core parts of school teaching and management. We have studied the teaching process theories at home and abroad and defined the teaching process in higher vocational colleges. The research group analyzed the input and output influencing variables in the whole process of higher vocational teaching, and noticed that the operation and management of higher vocational teaching is to manage the variation of the whole process of teaching. According to the 80/20 rule, 20% of the important influencing variables in the whole process of higher vocational teaching are well controlled, so as to add value to teaching activities and teaching processes, and make students’ learning and teaching results be integrated with knowledge and practice.

articleTitle: Innovation of Enterprise Economic Management Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern social economy, big data, artificial intelligence, block chain, cloud technology and other science and technology industries have penetrated into all sectors of society. The application of big data, cloud computing, artificial intelligence and other information technologies in enterprises has changed traditional enterprise models and promoted the formation of new business management models. Based on this background, the purpose of this paper is to provide a new thinking mode for enterprises with artificial intelligence technology, and to promote enterprises to transform from quantitative development to qualitative development. On the basis of traditional enterprises, this paper introduces advanced artificial intelligence technology to enhance the innovation ability of enterprises, and combines literature research method and case analysis method to design the scheme of promoting enterprise innovation by artificial intelligence technology from the perspective of theory and practice. The research results of this paper show that artificial intelligence is a strategic opportunity brought by the technological revolution. Under the guidance of artificial intelligence technology, the production efficiency of enterprises can be increased by 56% and the business opportunity of 30% increment can be brought, thus achieving the expected goal of bringing innovation and vitality to enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Constructing Distributed Data Lake Driven by Virtualization Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, the method of constructing distributed data lake driven by virtualization model is analyzed and studied. Through the selection of rich information resources, and the definition of the data model, combined with a set of data specifications of the virtualization model, the edge computing technology has achieved the self-governance of integrated economic internal data. Comparison and virtualization model-driven method of building distributed Data Lake are with logical and physical dispersion characteristics, and practice the purpose” of data handling. It not only solves the problem that some comprehensive economic entities do not want to upload the original data federation of industry and analysis the business demand for large data, but also is very good to meet the need of real-time processing business for live data, reduce the amount of data handling costs at the same time, and finally improve the economy.

articleTitle: Construction of Environmental Art Design System Based on Color Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Art design combines artistic form and aesthetic feeling with many factors such as society, culture, economy, market, science and technology, and reappears in the design closely related to our life, so that it not only has aesthetic function, but also has use function. By analyzing the present situation of image processing technology, this paper discusses the design and implementation of environmental art design system based on hierarchical structure by solving the key technologies such as image synthesis, image segmentation and file analysis. The object of interest is extracted by threshold segmentation, and the fuzzy connectivity is regarded as the redundant feature of the image, and then the fuzzy C-means clustering method is used to optimize the segmentation result of the previous step and improve the segmentation accuracy in the two-dimensional clustering space composed of redundant features and original image features. The method can effectively reduce the time of image segmentation while maintaining the segmentation accuracy.

articleTitle: Exploration of English Teaching Methods Based on Computer Corpus in Distance and Open Education Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: At present, the traditional English teaching mode has gradually withdrawn from the historical stage, and multimedia has been widely used in the process of distance open English teaching and achieved good results. The important feature of modern distance open education is to carry out various teaching activities under the network conditions. In college English teaching, corpora are widely used in language research and teaching, which has played an important role in improving the quality of college English teaching. The use of interactive activities in English teaching in distance and open education can bring good teaching results to English teaching, which is a brand-new model based on the law of language learning and classroom teaching rules. The traditional English teaching mode can not meet the needs of development. How to cultivate new compound talents with certain professional skills is the basic requirement of open education for English teaching. This paper discusses the feasibility of corpus in English teaching and how to apply corpus to English Teaching in distance and open education environment.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on University Financial Decision Based on Distributed Big Data Sharing Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer and network technology, in order to meet the needs of financial management, the financial management information system has been gradually improved. In this paper, the advantages of big data sharing based on distribution are analyzed in depth, and a data connection model based on distribution and distributed file system is established. It not only combines the actual working conditions of the financial departments of colleges and universities, but also simplifies the amount of data and information in the system, and designs the system flow completely according to the actual work flow, which strengthens the convenience and application effect of financial information management and decision-making in colleges and universities. Promote the integration of collective wisdom and data rationality in the decision-making process, thus breaking the limitations brought by traditional decision-making and establishing a democratic decision-making mechanism in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Investigation and Education Strategies of College Students’ Part-time Jobs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of economy, people have higher requirements for material and even spirit. In addition, the spare time of college is more than that of high university. Therefore, more and more college students stepped out of the ivory tower and began to engage in part-time jobs. Such things become more common. However, college students will inevitably encounter some problems in the part-time job due to inadequate experience and weak legal knowledge. And universities have failed to set up specialized institutions to establish a standardized part-time market to protect the legitimate rights and interests of students. "Should college students engage in part-time jobs", "how to deal with the relationship between part-time jobs and their studies", "how to obtain safe and reliable part-time information", and "what measures should colleges and universities take in this regard" have been hot topics in universities. In order to gain insight into the status and influence of part-time jobs for college students, so as to further develop education and management of students in the future, we conducted questionnaire surveys and on-site student interviews.

articleTitle: The Transformation and Development of Vocational Education in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence, as a universal technology that supports the transformation of all industries, promotes changes in various fields such as politics, economy, and society. Naturally, it also puts forward the requirements of transformation and innovation for the development of vocational education. This article explores the transformation and development of vocational education in the era of artificial intelligence in order to promote the ecological development of vocational education in my country. This article understands the status quo and changes of the development of vocational education in this profession by issuing questionnaires to the teachers and students of the professional robotics profession in A vocational colleges. It is concluded that 86.42% of teachers and students believe that the major is now more focused on training comprehensive talents; 93.71% of teachers and students believe that this major is now more concerned about the development of future society, and put forward the development strategy of vocational education in the era of artificial intelligence. The research in this article will help vocational colleges optimize their talent training programs and keep up with the development of the times to achieve the sustainable development of colleges.

articleTitle: Teaching Design of Vocal Music Course Group in Normal University Based on Intelligent Technology of Virtual Simulation Experiment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Virtual simulation technology has been widely used in many fields, including in the teaching process of many subjects in colleges and universities. However, little has been carried out in practical teaching of courses such as arts and physical education. This paper puts forward a course group teaching design of vocal music education in musicology. It demonstrates many aspects such as design ideas of experiment teaching, composition of virtual simulation experiment teaching simulator equipment, students' interactive operations, examination content of the experiment and evaluation system, and also discusses the embedded application of virtual simulation experiment teaching in vocal music related courses.

articleTitle: Intersection Algorithm and Application of Spatial Irregular Triangular Network in Environmental Engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In environmental engineering, by constructing method of irregular triangular mesh model, a bounding method is used to box out the two triangular grid models in the large number of invalid triangle units, supplemented by spatial encoding technology to further position set intersection triangles, after multi-endpoint sequencing, continuous periodic lines or closed loops are obtained to form the envelope surface, which ultimately enable digital simulation in the process of production.

articleTitle: Research on Mixed Teaching of Big Data Technology and Application Specialty Based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of science and technology students' individualized learning and obtain better teaching results, the author draws big data with the interactive teaching platform and analyses the learning behaviour of learners to summarize the general laws. "Online Offline" mixed teaching environment, differentiated mixed teaching method, mixed teaching method,it mixedevaluation focusing on process evaluation, effective integration of interactive teaching platform and teaching resources the aspect discussed restructures the mixed teaching mode.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Modeling Language and Tools in Postmodern Feminism
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The 1980s were a time period during which postmodern feminism spread across Japan and liberated traditional female figures in Japanese society. Postmodern feminism not only generated female writers' enthusiasm for literary creation, but also changed the traditional female images created by Japanese male writers. This paper will employ Haruki Murakami's Norwegian Wood to examine the impacts brought by postmodern feminism on female figures in male writers' literary work. Previous studies have mainly focused on the impacts of postmodern feminism on Japanese female authors. Therefore, this paper will aim to explore the changing attitudes of Japanese male writers and their thoughts towards females in the new era. I will argue that due to postmodern feminism, the depiction of female figures in literary creation have gradually changed from the traditional image of loyalty, weakness, or male sexual enlightenment, to new images concerned with their internal struggles. This paper will also explore the uniqueness of Japanese male authors through a comparative lens of female figures depicted by Japanese female authors during the age of postmodern feminism.

articleTitle: Discussion on Rural Residential District Planning Education under the Background of Territorial Space Planning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The proposal of rural revitalization strategy, the advancement of land and space planning, the adjustment of “urban and rural planning” to a first-level discipline, and the relevant national-level strategies and policies have promoted the coordinated development of urban and rural areas to an unprecedented height, which is important for the planning and construction of rural residential areas New requirements are put forward. The single rural planning education model under the traditional planning perspective has led to the aggravation of rural social problems. Therefore, in the context of land and space planning, diversified rural settlement planning education is based on ideological methods and disciplinary systems. All need to re-understand.

articleTitle: Exploration of Painting Creation Media and Concept Based on Visual Communication Design
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Painting and design are important parts of art. Since the origin of human beings, painting and design have developed together. Under the new media environment, digital painting, as a new creative form derived from traditional painting, is highly expressive in terms of content and effect. As independent disciplines, fine arts and design have no subordinate relationship with each other, but they are inextricably linked. In the constant exploration, the visual communication design coincides with the creation of digital painting, which creates a spark of wisdom. In our country's visual communication design, the integration and innovation of traditional painting art elements is the key to form a visual communication design with our unique artistic style. This paper analyzes the digital painting in the new media environment, starting from the two aspects of creative media and creative ideas, on the basis of traditional painting research, analyzes the new media environment based on the visual communication design of painting creation media and ideas.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Traditional Folk Paper-cut Art Design and Modern Graphic Design Based on Plane Composition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Chinese folk paper-cutting has a long history of development, and it is a major folk art form created by the working people of all ages in our country in order to meet the needs of material and spiritual life, and Return lived in it. It has become a design art rooted in the folk, and it is entrusted with the beautiful expectation of the broad working group from life. Plane composition is a very important part of modern design foundation. Points, lines and surfaces are not only the basic elements of plane composition, but also create a colorful environment atmosphere through the artistic treatment of points, lines and surfaces in different indoor environment designs. Many artistic inspirations of modern design come from folk paper-cutting, and we get creative inspiration and enlightenment from the structure and composition of paper-cutting. By studying the comparison between folk paper-cut art and modern graphic design, this paper tries to provide an innovative way for modern graphic design.

articleTitle: Research on Multimedia Swimming Teaching under Informatization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Computer technology, network technology and multimedia technology are developing rapidly and being used more and more widely, which brings hope for the modernization of educational technology and provides power for the reform of physical education. The use of multimedia courseware has solved many problems that conventional teaching can't solve or can't solve well, changed the monotonous, dull and dull atmosphere in classroom teaching in the past, and easily stimulated students' enthusiasm and interest in learning, so as to improve the comprehensive quality of college students. By means of teaching experiments, this paper analyzes the application effect of multimedia in college sports swimming class, and studies the application value of multimedia in college sports swimming class, hoping to have a certain positive impact and reference significance on improving the teaching quality of college sports swimming class.

articleTitle: Research on Project-based Curriculum and “Mini-Class” Teaching Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Project-based Curriculum teaching method is a new form of production of project instead of traditional teaching method, which integrates contents of project into the curriculum and enables students to complete production of project in the form of classes. “Mini-Class” is based on WeChat Subscription Number. Professional teacher of each course regularly pushes the core content of each lesson to their followers in the form of videos, pictures, text and other forms. The most important thing of “Mini-Class” is to realize barrier-free communication and interaction between teachers and students at any time and anywhere, and to truly realize the openness of e-learning.

articleTitle: Theory and Practice of Physical Education and Sports Training in Colleges and Universities Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: At present, the professional training of sports in our country still follows the teaching concept of coach standard, especially in the practical experience course activities, the classroom setting of sports training major still focuses on whether the students meet the predetermined requirements. To some extent, it ignores the psychological health requirements of students, violates the teaching principle of “health first”, and is not conducive to the cultivation of students' psychological quality. Based on the above background, the purpose of this study is to explore the theory and practice of physical education and sports training in Colleges and Universities Based on information technology. In this study, firstly, it is necessary to build a reliable safety network information system, and then analyze the theoretical and practical constraints of physical education and sports training in Colleges and universities, Let our college students have a significant improvement in physical literacy. The experimental results show that physical education in Colleges and universities only accounts for 10% of the courses in Colleges and universities. Therefore, we should establish the concept of coordinated development, build a strong teaching staff, reform teaching methods, contents and evaluation indicators, optimize teaching methods, scientifically design and reasonably carry out physical education, and promote the coordinated development of the two.

articleTitle: Discussion on Teacher-student Factors of Influencing Factors of Sergeant Vocational and Technical Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As individual participants at both ends of teaching activities, the subjective factors of teachers and students play a very important role in the development of Sergeant vocational and technical education. Effectively solving the problems existing in both teaching activities and seizing the opportunity for the development of college education reform is one of the current priorities of Sergeant Vocational and Technical Education institutions.

articleTitle: A Safe Semi-supervised Ensemble Method Combined with Active Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In view of the limitations of traditional semi-supervised ensemble learning and the characteristics of active learning, this paper proposes a safe semi-supervised ensemble method combined with active learning strategy (S3E-AL). The algorithm is improved on the basis of the traditional Tritraining algorithm, where three different classification algorithms are used to enhance the difference between the learners, and the classifier is integrated through the weighted voting method based on the classification accuracy, which improves the prediction accuracy. In combination with the active learning strategy, the samples with high confidence were selected for marking, and the reliability of the new markers was verified to reduce the addition of noise samples. At the same time, the low confidence samples with inconsistent votes were manually marked to make up for the defect that traditional semi-supervised ensemble learning only considers the samples with high confidence while ignoring those with low confidence but rich information. Finally, we use the data set on UCI to verify the availability and reliability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Art Education and College Students’ Ideology Education Method under Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Art education has unique value in innovating the ideological education model, connotation and path of college students, providing content and formal innovation for ideological education, and enhancing the influence and sustainability of ideological education. This paper conducts a questionnaire survey on college students from four universities in Province A on the current college students' mainstream ideological identity and the status of art education and ideological education. It is concluded that 85% of college students believe that mainstream ideological teaching should have practical teaching in addition to classroom teaching; 87% of college students believe that art education has brought formal innovation to ideological education and strengthened the educational effect; 80% of college students believe that the Marxist doctrine is helpful to our behavior guideline. Furthermore, it puts forward strategies to improve art education and ideological education of college students, so that ideological education can be better developed.

articleTitle: On the Reform and Innovation of College English Modular Teaching under the Background of Internet +
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Internet, the application of the Internet in education is gradually deepening. The combination of Internet and college English (CE) has promoted the improvement of English teaching methods and the promotion of teaching effect. The purpose of this paper is to promote the continuous improvement of CE teaching by reforming and innovating CE teaching. This paper first analyzes the specific characteristics of modular teaching from three aspects and explains the specific development direction of modular teaching. Then, on the basis of the investigation and analysis of English teaching, the present situation of English teaching is analyzed. The experimental results show that although the application proportion of modular English teaching method in college students' English teaching is increasing from 17.24% in 2014 to 34.29%, the overall application proportion is relatively low and needs to be further promoted.

articleTitle: A Discretization Method for Industrial Data Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: A parallel improvement of the traditional K-Means clustering algorithm is achieved based on the Mapreduce architecture, and the new parallelized clustering algorithm is used to realize the discretization of industrial big data in this paper. The new algorithm streamlines the calculation process, meanwhile, saves the computational overhead caused by data analysis and communication consumption caused by information transfer.

articleTitle: The Obstacles and Countermeasures Faced by the Informationization of College English Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Informatization” is one of the important keywords in the context of the current era. In many industries and fields, informatization has brought unprecedented thinking inspiration and technical impact, and in the field of English teaching, informatization has also brought profound Impact and rare opportunities. When it comes to the informatization of English teaching reform in colleges and universities, most people first think of specific technologies, products or application systems, such as micro-classes, mu-classes, multimedia technology, and TEP oral test system. In the background of the rapid development of Internet technology and mobile terminal technology, through the introduction of these information technology products, colleges and teachers can better use the efficient and convenient technical advantages of information technology, breaking the time and space limitations in traditional English teaching, And further cater to the information acquisition methods and English learning habits of students under the premise of conforming to the development trend of the times, so that the introduction of technology in English classrooms is at the forefront of the technology of education informatization, effectively ensuring the overall efficiency, quality and teaching of English teaching Standardization and data accuracy can reach a higher level.

articleTitle: Informational Teaching Concept in the Reform of College English Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: English education is an important and unusual basic subject from early childhood to higher education. The concept of informatization teaching has a positive effect on improving English education and teaching reform. College English (CE) teaching must strengthen the construction of software and hardware information, strengthen the cultivation of English teachers' information literacy, and improve the English teaching information level. The trend of higher education informatization (EI) is more obvious. In addition to the semi-social nature of colleges and universities (CAU), it is also one of the manifestations of information modernization. The traditional English teaching model has a single form, and the content is more tedious than the information model. The purpose of this article is to study the practical role of informatized teaching concepts in CE reform. This article uses a novel and effective teaching guidance method to optimize the application process of informatization teaching. Experiments show that improving the level of informatization teaching has a positive effect on English teaching in CAU.

articleTitle: Problems and Reform Ideas in Law Theory Teaching in Universities Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As an important part of the development of science and technology, big data analysis has been applied in many fields. While big data analysis has brought revolutionary influence to the legal industry, universities, as the primary source of legal talents, will inevitably bring invisible pressure to the traditional law teaching. In order to change this situation, we can reform the legal theory education from the aspects of law teaching mode, teaching system and talent training to adapt to the new mode of law education in the big data environment. The teaching research of law theory in universities under big data analysis not only increases the mode of law education, but also expands the development space of law theory teaching. Big data analysis will play an important role in the improvement of legal education, which will make it possible to realize the fairness of education and cultivate more excellent legal talents needed in the new era. According to the survey results, the learning effect of big data analysis on legal professional knowledge has been slightly improved by 31.13%, and the number of people who use websites to query relevant knowledge is as high as 85.71%. Aiming at the problems in law teaching process, this paper explores the reform of law theory teaching mode under the background of big data analysis.

articleTitle: “ROVer”-Low-Cost ROV for Innovative Ocean Education and Discovery
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper presents a low-cost, highly flexible hexagonal ROV that meets the requirement of oceanic exploration, discovery and particularly attracting for the marine science education. “ROVer” is an open-frame remote-controlled underwater vehicle with redundant safe design that has a protective design in terms of power drive and is suitable for students to construct ROVs in schools or off-campus environments and for underwater detection. The common low-cost raw PVC (Polyvinyl chloride) material is used as the frame support to reduce the weight and cost. The main structure with the hexahedron significantly improves the space utilization rate of the ROV's inner cabin and payload capability. The well designed control and communication system enables the real time observation and control functionality for users. This ROV is equipped with an image processing module to the software design for the shape recognition function of the vehicle. Several water pool tests have successfully proved ROVer's remote operation, image detection and video recording capabilities.

articleTitle: Reflection on the experience mode of Heritage Museum under the new media environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper discusses the deep experience mode of Heritage Museum under the development of new media art. Through the analysis of the exhibition problems of contemporary heritage museums, this paper explores the needs of visitors to enter the heritage museums, redefines the role of heritage museums in deep dimensions, and explores the interactive museum experience mode. According to the case analysis and summary, this paper puts forward the emotional experience of inter-subjectivity to meet the audience's demand for cultural connotation of the site, so that it can learn self exploration and creation in experience.

articleTitle: Analysis on Current Situation and Effect of Online Teaching Effect of Universities Based on Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Under the background of novel coronavirus pneumonia, all colleges and universities in China have carried out online teaching. In this special case, using case analysis method, this paper analyzed the situation and the effects of online teaching mode based on the data of a provincial university in southwest China, which is the study case. This paper puts forward some recommendations and prospects for the application of online teaching.

articleTitle: Study on the Effect Evaluation of Online Teaching and Learning of Higher Mathematics Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: At present, affected by the epidemic situation, using online platform teaching is a new challenge for teachers and students. In this paper, data envelopment analysis (DEA) is used to evaluate the learning effect of online teaching of higher mathematics, It will help teachers to master students' learning more comprehensively, improve teaching methods, and provide students with the direction to study higher mathematics better, and provide new ideas for the future online teaching.

articleTitle: How to Effectively Infiltrate Emotional Education in Primary School Chinese Teaching from Perspective of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Cultural inheritance and education is an important part of social development, primary school is an important period for children to receive cultural education, we should not only pay attention to the study of cultural courses but also pay attention to the infiltration of emotional education. With the development of the Internet, cloud technology and big data information in the field of education, the establishment of various education platforms and learning platforms has an increasing impact on primary school Chinese teaching. Based on this background, the purpose of this study is to combine the advanced technology of big data information with the efficient Chinese teaching in primary schools to improve the teaching quality. The research idea of this paper is to use big data information analysis and calculation in the emotional infiltration education of primary school Chinese teaching, analyze and demonstrate the data through the form of questionnaire and interview, and design the research scheme of how to effectively infiltrate emotional education in primary school Chinese teaching from the perspective of big data from the perspective of theory and practice. The research results of this paper show that in the emotional penetration education of Chinese teaching in primary schools, the proportion that the learning quality is affected by big data technology accounts for 67%, and the proportion that the emotional education has a positive impact on students accounts for 63%. The research results indicate that the active application of big data technology can effectively improve the quality of education and benefit the physical and mental health development of students. However, most teachers have little understanding and application of big data, and there is also the irrational phenomenon of emphasizing cognition and ignoring emotion.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Ancient and Modern Writing Habits Based on Ergonomics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Writing is an important act of human recording information, it involves the writer, writing tools and writing environment, which coincides with the three major elements of human, machine and environment in ergonomics. The writing habits of ancient China are very different from those of today. Therefore, in order to understand the ergonomics of Chinese ancient and modern Chinese writing habits, this article attempts to study and analyze the writing methods and habits of Chinese ancient and modern Chinese characters from the perspective of ergonomics.

articleTitle: Environmental Art Design Teaching Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the deepening of environmental art design teaching reform, big data-driven environmental art design teaching model is also constantly developing. The teaching of environmental art design is a specialty with outstanding characteristics in various disciplines of colleges and universities. Big data can provide rich teaching resources and teaching cases for environmental art design teaching. Promote the transformation of environmental art design teaching from the traditional teaching model to the new teaching model. This article uses big data analysis as the key word, searches the special reports published by core journals in the past five years, and surveys the teaching situation of 100 teachers. This article combines the application of big data in the field of education. From the perspective of big data analysis technology, explore and analyze new models and methods that are beneficial to the teaching of environmental art design. It can be seen from the survey data that 39.7% of the teaching method defects are single. Therefore, in order to improve teaching strategies and improve the educational evaluation system, we can truly meet the individualized learning needs of students. This article proposes that big data improves single teaching and turns to a mixed teaching model of environmental art design.

articleTitle: Adaptability of English Literature Translation from the Perspective of Machine Learning Linguistics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The development of computer networks has enabled the sharing and interaction of global information. In the information age, it is essential to use machine learning to transform disordered data into useful information. In the cultural exchanges of various countries, language conversion must not only meet the language environment of each country, but also meet the expression and aesthetic needs of the theme. The language conversion of English literary works is actually the re-creation of literature and art. The purpose of this article is to use machine learning to convert the language of excellent English literary works, so that readers can experience the literary and artistic beauty of English literary works in reading. This article takes English literature from the perspective of machine learning as the research object. It discusses the specific processing methods in translation and summarizes some translation strategies for English literary works, so as to provide references for the same type of translation. The language conversion of English literary works based on machine learning not only requires language conversion to meet the rationality of the language description of the original text. At the same time, the converted works should try their best to meet the pragmatic habits of the readers who use them.

articleTitle: The application of research teaching mode in the teaching reform of computer composition and structure
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Computer composition and structure is the core course for students to understand the working principle of computer and master the hardware characteristics of computer science and technology. Students feel boring and difficult to learn. In order to improve students' interest in learning and achieve the goal of cultivating innovative talents, the research-oriented teaching mode is introduced into the teaching reform of computer composition and structure, and the teaching method, teaching organization form and assessment method are comprehensively reformed to improve the teaching effect and teaching quality.

articleTitle: Design of Computer Basic Course Examination System Based on Virtual Simulation Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Digital campus construction is the key construction project of computer basic colleges, and online examination system is an indispensable part of it. The overall structure of the examination system adopts a browser-based three-tier network application system, which divides the functions of the system into three blocks: representation, function and data. A perfect Web-oriented examination system for computer basic courses with multiple questions is designed and implemented. The modules and database of the examination system are designed in detail, and the development of the computer basic examination system is realized. The network examination system designed in this paper is based on virtual simulation platform, which is a test of teachers' teaching level and students' learning situation. The purpose is to make teachers and students get the most timely and effective feedback, so as to give teachers and students the greatest help in future teaching activities.

articleTitle: Research on the Microcarrier of College Students’ Management and Political Education Based on BP Neural Network under the Background of Internet +
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Due to the rapid progress of Internet technology in my country, Internet technology has been popularized in various industries in different fields. The use of teaching methods based on “Internet +” in the ideological and political education of college students will help students shape new ideological and political forms and improve their mental health. The use of microcarriers enables universities to develop effective and targeted methods of ideological and political education based on the personal physique of college students. Based on the fact that the micro-carrier culture dissemination reflects the more significant characteristics of the development of the times, it has brought new ideas to the ideological and political education of the university, so that it can more fully manifest its infectious effect The innovation of teaching technology based on “Internet+” has given new vitality to the ideological and political education of universities. The article will combine the analysis of the effect of BP neural network on college ideological and political education, and explore the micro-carriers of college students' ideological and political education in the “Internet +” era.

articleTitle: The design of three contest responder based on CDIO
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Engineering education model of CDIO is the latest achievement of international engineering education reform. CDIO focus on cultivating the engineering consciousness of the students.It is a major challenge to achieve the complete class teching in so less class hour casued by the adujusting of the professional talent cultivating plan. This paper introduces education reform of electrical engineering and electronics based on CDIO. It takes the three-person answering circuit as an example to design the teaching mode of CDIO.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Multimedia Technology in University Network Ideological and Political Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Colleges and universities are the most informatized places in our society. With the widespread application of computer and network technology, the Internet has become an important channel for college students to acquire knowledge and various information, and is important for college students' study, life, and ideas. Both have a broad and profound impact. College ideological and political education is bound to face how to respond to the challenges and opportunities brought about by new technologies. This article examines the network ideological and political education system in China's colleges and universities from a new perspective. This paper discusses the construction of a network platform for ideological and political education of college students, and opens up new carriers and new channels for teacher-student communication and communication. The platform breaks the time and space limitations of the traditional ideological and political education model, improves teaching efficiency and quality, and is very useful for realizing true quality education and flexible and individualized education, and training qualified socialist builders and successors. Significance.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of "Two Courses in One" Teaching of Computer Foundation and Programming in Independent Colleges
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Promoting the teaching of "Two Courses in One" of computer foundation and programming is helpful to the effective promotion of computer science and technology in our country. This paper mainly introduces the teaching advantages of "Two Courses in One" in computer foundation and program design, discusses the implementation elements of "Two Courses in One" teaching scheme, and proposes a three-stage "Two Courses in One" teaching design scheme of reorganizing course content, optimizing teaching scheme and arousing deep integration. The integration of online teaching, situational teaching and cooperative teaching promotes the implementation of the "Two Courses in One" reorganization teaching plan, aiming at optimizing the teaching environment and deepening the educational purpose.

articleTitle: Military Education Robot Based on Wireless Signal
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Children's education has always attracted the attention of the masses and children's education largely determines the height to be achieved in the future. The education methods adopted by many parents are mostly forced, compulsory, which will cause great pressure on the child's psychology, and even have serious consequences such as aversion to learning. So, how to let children learn in a pleasant environment with fun? The military education robot we designed will do so. With a OpenMV camera, it can transmit images in real time, with a self-designed APP for robot motion control and cloud head control. It also equipped with a firing device and can maximize the simulation of the first perspective of tank driving. The most important thing is that it can intelligently identify different colors at the APP, which will pull out different military knowledge for learning, maximizing the interest of the child and allows the child to consciously learn knowledge in the process of playing. Besides, the design also applies to military enthusiasts. In today's environment, the situation at home and abroad is not very peaceful, many people are very concerned about military information, and Chinese military fans are also a very large group. Thus our military education robot may apply to these people, which has the main functions of tanks, the maximumsimulation of tanks, further deepening military fans'understanding of tanks.

articleTitle: College Students’ Comprehensive Quality Evaluation System Based on Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the current era of rapid development of information society, most of the work is developed and progressed rapidly with the help of computer systems.
