In the process of vigorously promoting education informatization, many colleges and universities have started information systems such as educational administration and student management and accumulated a large amount of complete data, but managers' use of data is limited to query and result analysis. With the development of Chinese contemporary university construction and school teaching management, the workload of students' data information management and maintenance will also increase. Using association rules to comprehensively analyze the basic situation of college graduates can quickly, accurately and efficiently excavate the factors affecting a person's comprehensive quality from a large amount of information, which has important guiding significance for families and schools. In order to reflect the comprehensive quality of students more effectively, this paper discusses the basic structure and design idea of the comprehensive quality evaluation system for college students based on association rules.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Teacher-Student Collaborative Assessment in Business English Writing Teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Over the years, the way of feedback on business English writing teaching mainly focus on teacher’s feedback, which leads to the slow progress of students’ English ability due to the difficulty of giving timely and effective feedback to them. This paper summarizes the advantages and disadvantages of the former writing feedback methods, and tries to summarize the advantages of TSCA compared with other feedback methods by studying its application in business English writing teaching. This study takes the sophomores in business English of Wuhan Business University as the research objects, collects relevant data through experimental research and questionnaire survey. The study shows that, to some extent, TSCA can save teachers’ time, improve the feedback efficiency, and enhance the communication between teachers and students. Most students have a positive attitude towards TSCA.

articleTitle: Research on Landscape Planning and Design of Urban Point Public Space Based on Computer Virtual Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The excellent landscape of urban public space can lead to rich urban life, but the current situation of China's construction shows some shortcomings, which is not conducive to the proceduralization and systematization of the landscape design process. The landscape of urban public space reflects modern people's values, aesthetics and interests. However, there are still many problems in the planning and design of urban public space landscape, and there are many unsatisfactory landscape designs. The application of computer technology in urban landscape construction can make landscape construction more standardized and scientific, from early geological verification to preliminary scheme research to later simulated environment design. As the carrier of people's social activities, public space has emerged some urgent problems. The research on the layout and mode of urban point public space is conducive to solve the current problems. This paper introduces the key technology of computer virtual technology, and provides some reference for improving the development efficiency of urban point public space landscape.

articleTitle: Cultivating Higher-Order Skills Based on the Connotation and Teaching Logic of Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: How to effectively cultivate higher-order skills is the focus of global educational reforms. The key to developing higher-order skills is to promote students' deep learning. This article starts from the connotation and teaching logic of deep learning, and reveals the relationship between deep learning and the cultivation of higher-order abilities. It also puts forward five suggestions on how teachers can cultivate students' higher-order skills, further providing references for the development of higher-level abilities in the actual teaching implementation process. The contents of five suggestions are: 1. Stimulating students' learning motivation and grasping the implicit value goals; 2. Attaching importance to the design of student activities and strengthening the expansion of critical thinking; 3. Preventing false cooperation and establishing an effective learning community; 4. Paying attention to students' existing experience and promoting the development and creation of knowledge; 5. Arousing students to reflect on learning and boosting the realization of meaningful learning.

articleTitle: The enlightenment of the cultural elements of paper-cut to the creation of modern animation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This electronic document is a “live” template and already defines the components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] in its style sheet. Chinese folk paper cutting is a traditional cultural treasure of our country, is the ideological and cultural history of the nation, is the spiritual value of our nation. Paper-cut is a symbolic art with a strong culture. It stores the most original aesthetic spirit of the ancient Chinese nation. It comes from nature and is close to the people. And animation this is a technology and art is a body comprehensive art, it is endowed with new forms and value, but the cultural connotation of Chinese animation carries more and more weak, lack of the Chinese characteristics, so in the contemporary animation production to join the national culture symbol, from the paper-cut elements “form, meaning,” revelation of modern animation, make together, the collision between different civilizations, the art form of expression more rich.

articleTitle: The Support of Internet Technology in Physical Education Classroom in the New Coronary Pneumonia Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The sudden new coronary pneumonia epidemic disrupted the normal teaching order. In response to the call to "suspend classes and non-stop classes", schools have launched network teaching. Based on the background of the new crown pneumonia epidemic, and to explore the impact of Internet technology to Physical play sports classroom superiority, the National Science Services epidemic prevention and control needs. In the context of this paper, the new crown pneumonia epidemic, teachers and students of different educational stages A City (primary, secondary, university) and parents of students conducted a survey questionnaire online sports teaching situation, on the whole, during the epidemic of Internet technology for sports while supporting classroom teaching, it also has a great impact. 86.5 percent of students, teachers and parents believe that the main classroom of high school students online sports into full play, but 75.3% of the teachers and students have experienced problems over the network Caton, resulting in the complete study can not be taught, affect learning and other issues. This study will help to promote better integration of Internet technology and physical education, physical education classrooms full line of quality education.

articleTitle: Discussion on the teaching application of VR technology in bronze ware making process
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Under the background of new era, the Internet technology development, and is widely applied in the field of education, for the combination of virtual reality technology and bronze craftsmanship provides a possible, because of the virtual reality technology has the characteristics of immersion, interactivity and idea, to build a platform for interaction between learners and teaching, let learners in virtual 3 d interactive virtual experience, thus giving absorbed new identity makes it not restricted by space-time capture learning skills quickly. Based on the course teaching of bronze ware making process, this paper applies cutting-edge VR virtual technology to the teaching platform to solve the problems of traditional bronze ware making process complexity and high risk coefficient, and expounds its advantages, so as to improve the success rate of bronze ware making in the actual operation process.

articleTitle: Translation Strategies of Long and Difficult Sentences in English Linguistics Academic Works under Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The arrival of the era of big data has brought tremendous changes to people's life, work and study. International academic exchanges are increasingly showing their important position, and academic translation has assumed this important task. The translation of long and difficult sentences in English linguistics academic works has always been an important difficulty in English linguistics. The purpose of this article is to explore the translation strategies for long and difficult sentences in English linguistics works in the context of big data, in order to follow up on linguistics and the same field Translators provide reference. Based on the big data environment, this paper issues questionnaires to English majors in a certain university, and investigates and analyzes the problems and status quo in the translation of long and difficult sentences in English linguistics academic works. According to the analysis, 86.5% of the students are facing the problem of inaccurate grasp of highly professional articles; 60.8% of students faced the problem that the translation content expression is complete, but not smooth, and put forward related translation strategies. Provide reference for the translation of subsequent academic works, so that the translated long and difficult sentences can meet the reader's reading habits.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Key Technologies for Transforming Formatted Data into Natural Language Text
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Office automation systems generally process data in XML and other formats when storing and exchanging information, which can make the computer more convenient for automatic processing to improve work efficiency. However, such data files are not easy for the average person to read. In everyday applications, this approach is not applicable on a large scale and requires editing and drawing natural language text reports based on formatted data. Most of this work is completed manually by the user, which is repeated in the work, resulting in no significant improvement in office efficiency. Therefore, in order to improve the real-time efficiency of work, people need to conduct in-depth research on the conversion mechanism from formatted data to natural language text. This system can carry out automatic data processing according to the characteristics of official document report of the office system, so as to reduce the burden of users.

articleTitle: A Study on the Application of Bayesian Networks in the English Proficiency Test in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: By using Bayesian network and the K2 algorithm, a test model of vocational English application ability can be established. Through the Bayesian network classifiers, it can analyze the English application ability of comprehensive factors. As a result, we could find that the Bayesian network classifiers will affect the application of English ability. Through the analysis of these factors, and according to the analysis of the data for verification, it shows that the results of the validation are in conformity with the actual situation, and through the study of the application of the model, the direction for higher vocational students of English learning can be indicated, which can be used to support the management and reform in higher vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Research on the Training of English Talents in Cross-border E-commerce Business
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the progress of globalization and the innovation of network technology, the global cross-border ecommerce industry is developing rapidly, and the demand for cross-border e-commerce English talents in the market continues to increase. As the main position for the society to train professionals to meet the needs of social development, the training of cross-border e-commerce talents is facing new situations and requirements. This paper analyzes the current situation of the demand for talents in the development of cross-border e-commerce in my country, and the problems existing in the training of cross-border e-commerce talents in colleges and universities, and puts forward the reform opinions on the training of cross-border e-commerce talents in colleges and universities for reference.

articleTitle: Research on College Students’ Psychological Crisis Early Warning Method Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: College students are the hope of the nation and the future of the motherland. However, the frequent psychological crisis of college students gives us vigilance. The application of fuzzy cluster analysis in the analysis of college students' mental health can find out the potential relationship among the factors affecting mental health, and provide reference for the early prevention of college students' mental health problems. On the surface, the psychological crisis of college students seems to be sudden, accidental and unpredictable. But in fact, college students' psychological crisis has a specific process of emergence and development. The establishment of College Students' psychological crisis early warning system is an important means to effectively prevent psychological crisis and weaken its influence, which is one of the focuses of Ideological and political education for college students. In this paper, the fuzzy clustering algorithm is used to analyze the mental health of college students, and the early warning method of psychological crisis is studied, in order to provide theoretical and practical reference for colleges and universities to carry out targeted mental health education and improve their mental health level.

articleTitle: Research on Movie Role Shaping Method Based on Computer 3D Animation Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of computer 3D animation technology, computer 3D animated films have gradually become one of the major commercial films in the world. Computer 3D animated film provides the audience with the convenience of enjoying the film from multiple angles, and has wide artistic and commercial value. In animated films, animated characters are the core of the film, which also determines the final interpretation of animated works. As an important part of computer 3D animated films, characters play an irreplaceable role. The appropriate performance characteristics of the characters in the film can enhance the realistic sense of the role's action, reflect the purpose of the character's action, and deeply show the various characteristics of the character, so that the role in the 3D animation is more real and the character image is more full. Based on the analysis of 3D animation film character performance, this paper summarizes the characteristics of 3D film role performance and the elements of art shaping.

articleTitle: Teaching Reform Practice of Simulated Electronic Technology Course Based on SPOC
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The integration of information technology and education can change the way of learning. SPOC has become a new way of education and colleges and universities have begun to use the SPOC teaching method, but the teaching effect of this method is still to be improved and tested. SPOC online and classroom teaching mode mainly involve two aspects to carry out teaching activities. The traditional teaching mode may ignore the students' ability of performance, then it will be hard to meet the teaching needs of SPOC. The key in the learning process mainly refers that how much learning behaviour based on the study effects survey measurement provides a new perspective. Therefore, the input amount of learning behavior becomes the foothold, which helps teachers grasp the learning dynamics of students through an in-depth analysis of the status of learning behavior.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Image Recognition Based on Edge Calculation in Landscape Painting
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Landscape painting is a unique art form. Compared with other artistic styles, most of the styles reflected are abstract, subjective, results texturing texture, colour, layout, lines and other high-level semantic features. Landscape painting artistic style feature extracting is presented in this paper, based on the structure of normal distribution parameters on authentic work model. Through the thorough analysis and deep study of traditional landscape painting in the digital based on digital image, it is formed by the in pixel domain through digital description of content and style of landscape painting, and a new algorithm of image analysis is compared. Using machine learning and the input vector for the remaining classification of landscape painting and based on the classification of different content and style, we could get a better identification effect.

articleTitle: The Construction of Realistic Environment of Deep Learning Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Virtual environment created based on virtual reality can promote learners' deep learning experience. It enables learners' immersive exploration and interaction with the real environment. In this way they can have their personalized learning experience and continuous feedback. Virtual reality, which creates an immersive and interactive environment, leads to a better teaching model where students' previous learning pattern is changed. At present, virtual reality technology is becoming increasingly mature, and research on the application of virtual reality in education is drawing more attention from educators. The article analyzes the learning pattern enabled by virtual reality, and I believe that the advantages of virtual reality in the construction of deep learning mainly lie in environment construction, experience design, behavior guidance, and learning transfer.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Optimization Strategies of Ecological College English Teaching Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: At present, the college English classroom teaching model based on artificial intelligence is more abundant than before, but the phenomenon of classroom ecological imbalance is still relatively serious. This article aims at optimizing college English classroom teaching under artificial intelligence from the perspective of ecological teaching to achieve coordinated and sustainable development of college English teaching. In this paper, through a questionnaire survey and interviews with freshmen in A universities about the current situation of ecological university English classroom teaching in the era of artificial intelligence, 65% of the students recognized that artificial intelligence has enriched teaching resources and expanded knowledge. However, the English classroom is still dominated by traditional teaching models, which is not conducive to the development of artificial intelligence teaching models. Combined with the relevant theories of educational ecology, this paper proposes an optimization strategy for college English teaching based on artificial intelligence. The research in this article helps to create a balanced and ecological college English classroom and achieve the optimal teaching.

articleTitle: Practical Teaching Methods of Finance and Economics Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the continuous update of information technology and the continuous development of education, the society has a large number of needs for financial professionals, but in the construction of financial professional information, there are problems such as the same personnel training mode and curriculum. The purpose of this paper is to realize the practical teaching of Finance and economics through information technology. In this paper, through a comparative survey of practical teaching in the University of Finance and economics, two subjects are selected as the survey objects, namely, the network class (n=27) and the control class (n=29). The network class uses information technology to carry out the practical teaching of Finance and Economics, and the control class uses the traditional face-to-face teaching method. At the end of the experiment, the mastery of practical knowledge of the two classes and the influence on information-based teaching methods were investigated and analyzed. The experimental results show that the knowledge mastery level of the network class is higher than that of the control class. It can be seen that information teaching plays an important role in the practical teaching of Finance and economics.

articleTitle: Research on information sharing strategy in back-up procurement considering decision-maker’s risk preference
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Based on a supply chain system composed of two suppliers and two competing manufacturers with risk preferences, this paper studies the information sharing in the upstream of the supply chain under supply uncertainty. Considering the different risk preference characteristics of the manufacturer, the information sharing strategy in the back-up procurement under supply uncertainty is proposed. Through numerical analysis, it is found that whether the manufacturer makes information sharing decision depends on the output of the main supplier and the cost of information sharing. In addition, when the risk preference of the manufacturer is high, it is less willing to share the information of the main supplier with the backup supplier.

articleTitle: Research on interactive mode of children’s museum based on guided teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper expounds the interactive mode of children's Museum immersive experience based on the guiding education concept. Through the analysis of children's physiological and psychological characteristics as well as the corresponding educational methods in childhood, we can find out the real needs of children to enter the museum, understand the role of the museum in a deep dimension, and explore the interactive museum experience mode.

articleTitle: The Exploration and Practice of Undergraduate Talent Cultivation Model in International Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the context of the construction of new engineering disciplines, combined with the characteristics of local colleges and universities and the certification of engineering education, in order to exploring the training mode of undergraduate talents with an international perspective in ordinary universities. After extensive research and discussion, the project has determined the training goals of international students, combined with the professional certification of engineering education. Determine the students' graduation requirements and form a training plan.

articleTitle: Innovation of the Chinese International Education Training Model Based on Situational Creation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Chinese international education is an educational course that has been rising in recent years and is popular with other countries in the world. In Chinese international education, because of the particularity of the object of education, it is also required that the mode and form of education must be different from the domestic conventional education, and we should pay more attention to the creation and construction of the situation in the teaching process, so as to better cultivate students' Chinese language ability and promote the application and popularization of Chinese teaching abroad. Based on the oral teaching of Chinese international education, this paper briefly analyzes the concept of situational creation and its role in the oral teaching of Chinese international education, and puts forward the application measures of situational creation in the teaching process.

articleTitle: Construction of Virtual Simulation Practical Teaching Platform for Ideological and Political Theory Course
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Teachers of ideological and political theory should adhere to the correct political direction, love the cause of Marxist theory education, and have good ideological and moral character. Teachers who are not consistent with the Party Central Committee on issues concerning political principles, political stand and political direction are not allowed to engage in ideological and political teaching. In fact, the practical teaching of ideological and political theory courses is to put the Marxist world outlook and outlook on life into practice. Its educational goal is to cultivate the students' ability to discover, analyze and solve problems, and to cultivate the students' spirit of inquiry. The spirit of innovation and the spirit of practice enable the educator to analyze and solve problems consciously with Marxist basic stand, viewpoint and method at any time.

articleTitle: Gamification and Predictive Analytics for the Next Generation of Workers
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The implementation of psychological theories in the study of gamification has played an important role in our digital lives as multiple social media and gaming apps compete to harness user engagement to stay popular and relevant. A review of psychological theories that induce extrinsic and intrinsic motivations in the workplace, as well as the current applications of game elements in a non-gamified environment, is done in this report. Following that, a new gamified model is proposed that uses real-time data, Weibull statistical distribution, and a k-means clustering algorithm along with a reward system that would help increase skill development, employee satisfaction, and workforce retention.

articleTitle: Research on University Ideological and Political Education Based on Big Data Information Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Education is moving towards the era of big data. Nowadays, the value of data and data analysis can be reflected everywhere in college ideological and political education. The processing process of ideological and political education big data can be basically divided into four stages: data perception and collection, data processing and integration, data analysis and data interpretation. With the help of web log analysis, social network analysis, and correlation analysis, the ideological and political education big data Analysis can make the decision-making process of ideological and political education more scientific, and the measures formulated are more targeted and more in line with educational needs. Of course, information security and the difficulty of data acquisition also bring challenges to the application of big data in ideological and political education.

articleTitle: The Application of Computer Information Big Data Technology in College English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology and network technology, human society has entered the era of big data. In this context, the application of computers and the Internet is becoming more and more widespread, and it has become an important productivity in many industries, greatly improving the efficiency and quality of production and work. Big data and cloud computing are a new type of computing model, which greatly promotes the education and teaching of colleges and universities. It can achieve the efficient integration of various resources through network information sharing. Under the network environment, students' independent learning has become a broad learning model and basic requirement of English education. Based on this research background, the thesis uses Agent agents to build an autonomous English learning platform to cultivate students' personalized and collaborative capabilities. The characteristics of online English self-learning are expounded, and the construction process of multi-agent model is discussed in detail. Experiments prove that the platform can improve students' learning efficiency and comprehensive practical ability, and the proposed scheme has strong research value.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of “Four Difficult Students” Based on Contextual Awareness in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the predictive effect of the “four difficult students” is difficult to achieve the expected results, a context-aware framework of the “four difficult students” inclined student prediction is proposed. This framework introduces the contextual factors in the environment of students, and further explores the relationship between the students, their situations, and the characteristics of the “four difficult students At the same time, the framework improves the ability of dimensionality reduction and prediction generalization in feature selection. The experimental results show that the context-aware “four difficult students” tendency student prediction framework can be effectively applied to “four difficult students” tendency prediction, so as to provide powerful early warning and timely intervention for the management work of college students.

articleTitle: Teaching Research of College Computer Specialty Based on Application-Oriented Talents Training
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Cultivating application-oriented technical talents is the basic goal of ordinary undergraduate colleges to train students. Clarify the goal of computer professional talent training, propose a new model of talent training, and discuss in detail from the aspects of talent training curriculum system construction, teaching content, teaching methods, practical teaching, teacher team construction, etc. The methods and methods of the application-oriented talent training model have been explored and studied.
